scope.owned_layer: Supervisor task-row/worker-run assignment evidence, active assignment-drift reconciliation, duplicate active-run suppression, and optimistic stale-failure reassignment guards.

implementation.assignment_capture: start_worker_for_request records task_assignment_at_dispatch beside the supervisor-issued status_command_runtime source SHA.
implementation.reconciliation_phase: reconcile_worker_task_assignments runs before the first worker poll and after the post-dispatch worker poll. The canonical task row remains authoritative.
implementation.active_drift_action: A worker whose dispatch identity no longer matches the authoritative owner/reviewer/status is marked superseded and its queue lease is finalized exactly once. Ending a *live* process additionally requires the canonical governance lease decision to authorize it: reconciler-observed drift alone never kills a running worker.
implementation.duplicate_action: For multiple authoritative active runs on one task, the oldest matching incumbent remains and later matching runs are superseded. Delegated fallback parent/child records are not misclassified as accidental duplicates.
implementation.terminal_visibility: Recently terminal runs remain unchanged but appear in the runtime evidence join with row owner, reviewer, status, run id, queue event, PID, exit code, source SHA, and assignment-match result.
implementation.stale_failure_guard: Failure-driven reassignment supplies expected_owner and expected_reviewer to the locked canonical write. If either changed after failure observation, the write fails and stale_worker_failure_reassignment_skipped records the exact before/after rows and run evidence.
implementation.health_reporting: Runtime summaries report assignment_truth=unknown until a reconciliation report exists; verbose output prints the exact joined fields before reporting healthy or drift.
implementation.reopen_fix: Reopen of 791e320a3 (2026-08-06T16:11:20Z) raised three blocking sub-items. 67496cd60 closed two: worker_matches_current_assignment was restored to its original role/status semantics (dependency_done_statuses early return, return False default) so its four other call sites are unaffected by dispatch snapshot presence, and worker_dispatch_assignment_changed was added as a reconciler-local helper that exclusively uses the dispatch snapshot comparison. The third sub-item -- routing the live terminate/supersede decision through active_worker_governance_lease_decision -- was only cosmetic in 67496cd60: the call passed activity_events=None (which makes the decision unconditionally preserve/governance_only_transition), its result was discarded via `_ = lease_decision`, the accompanying comment claiming the value was used in evidence logging was false, and the process was terminated regardless. 7d36e07bf makes the guard real; see governance_lease_guard.
implementation.governance_lease_guard: reconcile_worker_task_assignments loads worker_governance_activity_snapshot(config) lazily (only when a loser is actually alive) and passes it to active_worker_governance_lease_decision, the same guard the poll_workers supersede path uses. action != 'terminate' records one deduplicated record_worker_governance_lease_guard observation and skips the supersede; a failed terminate_worker_process_generation records the same authorized_transition_termination_pending_confirmation / authorized_transition_process_identity_unproven reason codes as poll_workers. The chosen reason_code and source_event_id are carried into both the assignment_reconciliation evidence and the worker_assignment_reconciled audit event. A preserved worker stays active and unmatched, so it is still counted in active_drift_count and the report status stays 'drift' rather than 'healthy'.
